name: GitGuardian MCP Server
description: Enables AI agents to scan projects for leaked secrets and manage security incidents using GitGuardian's comprehensive API. It supports automated secret detection, honeytoken creation, and remediation workflows to secure codebases without context switching.

rawRecord.description: Enables AI agents to scan projects for leaked secrets and manage security incidents using GitGuardian's comprehensive API. It supports automated secret detection, honeytoken creation, and remediation workflows to secure codebases without context switching.

MCP_PORT.description: Port for HTTP/SSE transport (when set, enables HTTP transport instead of stdio, requires ENABLE_LOCAL_OAUTH=false)

ENABLE_LOCAL_OAUTH.description: Enable local OAuth flow (stdio mode only, cannot be used with MCP_PORT)

GITGUARDIAN_TOKEN_NAME.description: Name for the OAuth token (Auto-generated based on server type if not set)

GITGUARDIAN_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Personal Access Token for authentication (alternative to OAuth)
